description: This file defines React hooks and state management for handling context menus in the Notesnook application, including opening, closing, and resolving menu items, with platform-specific behavior for desktop environments.

methods.name: useMenuTrigger
methods.description: Provides functions and state to trigger and control menu visibility and target.

methods.name: Menu.openMenu
methods.description: Opens a menu with specified items and options.

methods.name: Menu.isOpen
methods.description: Checks if a menu is currently open.

methods.name: Menu.target
methods.description: Retrieves the target element for the menu.

methods.name: useMenu
methods.description: Hook to access current menu items and options.

methods.name: resolveMenuItems
methods.description: Recursively resolves lazy-loaded menu items into a flat list.

methods.name: findAndCallAction
methods.description: Finds a menu item by ID and executes its onClick handler.

methods.name: canShowNativeMenu
methods.description: Determines if native menu can be shown based on item types.
